t2.thesis: SNAP enters earnings beaten down and cheap with a large implied move, so the open-to-open reaction is close to a coin flip with a slight tilt from depressed sentiment offset by a weak recent guide record.
reasons: Base rates for AMC software/internet names sit near 54%, with no strong dossier signal to move far from it
Stock is down 28% over 12 months and 39% from its 52w high, with low expectations and 7.5% short interest, which gives rebound potential on a decent print
Implied move of about 13.8% (IV about 3x realized vol) means the outcome depends on guidance, not the EPS number
Last four reactions were split 2 up, 2 down despite EPS beats every time, so beats are not informative
Teen lawsuit settlements remove some legal overhang, but the Chief Business Officer departure and the 5% drop on Oct 30 after Reddit's print show sector caution
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 guidance for revenue and adjusted EBITDA, together with DAU trend (North America and Europe declining) and ad-platform growth.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 0.542; AMC 0.538; software_internet cluster 0.541

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-03, so that earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how SNAP's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 0.04 from 0.54 because of a coin-flip history of reactions despite consistent EPS beats, weak sector tape and the executive departure, partly offset by the depressed positioning and cheap valuation.

theses.expected: Stock rises on revenue growth near 19% and an EBITDA beat with a firm Q4 guide
theses.mechanism: Low expectations and short interest produce a relief rally from a depressed base
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guide implies deceleration below about 15% growth

theses.expected: Stock falls on a soft guide or DAU decline
theses.mechanism: North America and Europe DAU erosion plus competition and ad-platform changes weigh on the multiple
theses.wrong_if: DAUs grow and management gives upbeat ad-demand commentary

theses.expected: Muted move, with the open-to-open outcome decided by overnight sentiment
theses.mechanism: Option-implied move of about 14% may be overpriced given IV about 3x realized vol

key_observations: Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance versus consensus
Global and North America DAU trend
Free cash flow and the buyback or share count commentary
Direct revenue and Snapchat+ subscription growth
Legal settlement costs and any new accrual
